document.abstract: 3-D subband coding as a video compression system is particularly well suited for use where inexpensive, simple encoders are needed. Program production or teleconferencing are good examples. Since the system uses octave width bands it is inherently scalable. Real-time programmable hardware has been built to process video at various bit rates using this technique. The results of these tests will be demonstrated.
